children.text: Participants
ThinkByte: Pavan, Satish Chitturi, Harsha Thota, Charan Kumar
Arshitadoaba
Abhi
Key Takeaways
The team's Facebook ad account was restricted on January 5th, and attempts to resolve the issue with Facebook support have been ongoing, with no clear reason for the blockage provided.
A backup plan involves creating a new business manager and ad account, as well as seeking a refund for the restricted account, although the refund process has faced challenges.
Efforts to communicate with Facebook support have been difficult, with suggestions to create multiple business accounts to prevent future disruptions.
The team is considering using Google Ads as an alternative, noting that while costs may be higher, the quality of leads is expected to be better.
There is a need to improve the company's online presence, including optimizing the landing page and enhancing the Facebook page with better visuals and descriptions.
Action Items
Expressed uncertainty about the approval process and the lack of clarity regarding future actions.
Indicated that they would submit their work, commit other uncommitted changes, and then review everything.
Abhishek Agrawal
Collaborate on strategies for account issues and ads.
To create a new plan of action due to the current lack of clarity on whether the approval will be granted or not.
Review and improve the website and Facebook page.
The team will send the ads prepared in Spanish language for foreclosure to Abhishek for validation by his Spanish speakers.
Harsha Thota
Create and monitor new business and ad accounts.
Coordinate and update project tasks with the team.
Collaborate with the design team on ad content and compliance.
Prepare and share documents for communication and strategy.
Facebook Ad Account Restriction
Lack of communication from Facebook provided no specific reasons for restriction, making resolution difficult.
Account restricted January 5th due to potential policy violations, payment issues. Initial request resolution rejected by Facebook's automated system January 7th.
Conduct internal discussions to explore alternatives if restriction not lifted, including backup plans like creating new ad accounts.
Automated restrictions by Facebook AI led to account suspension, affecting business operations.
Consider creating additional ad accounts, business manager accounts to prevent future disruptions, ensure business continuity.
Contacting Facebook Support
Frequent interaction with Facebook support team necessary to resolve account issues and understand reasons behind restrictions.
Need effective methods quickly reach human support further delays resolution.
Develop strategies efficiently reach human support to expedite resolution process.
Challenges reaching human support representatives, as AI-driven processes create barriers.
Use profiles with good reputation improve chances connecting Facebook support representatives.
Refund Request and Financial Concerns
Difficulty retrieving funds due to broken links, lack of direct communication with Facebook finance team.
Continue raising tickets, pursuing communication with Facebook support to resolve financial issues, ensure refund process is completed.
Efforts to secure refund for unutilized funds due to account restriction were hindered by technical issues, such as non-functional refund form links.
No confirmation or case number provided, complicating follow-up on refund requests.
Backup Strategies and Business Continuity
Development of backup strategies, including alternative ad accounts, to ensure business continuity in case of future restrictions.
Create multiple ad accounts, business manager accounts as contingency plan to mitigate risk of future restrictions.
Potential disruptions from account restrictions require proactive measures to maintain business operations.
Scam Communications
Identification of scam communications posing as Facebook messages, leading to enhanced caution in verifying authenticity of communications.
Potential security threats through spam messages could compromise account security and data integrity.
Implement heightened verification measures to ensure authenticity of communications from Facebook, safeguard against scams.
Website and Landing Page Optimization
Current pop-up configurations and contact information forms may not meet user expectations or best practices.
Remove unnecessary pop-ups, ensure contact information is intuitive, provide clear, accessible contact details for users.
Optimization of website landing pages, contact information to improve user experience, adhere to best practices.
Google Ads Strategy
Exploration of Google Ads as alternative advertising platform, considering its policy differences and higher quality lead potential compared to Facebook.
Google Ads may incur higher costs, but lead quality, intent justify investment.
Research Google Ads policies, especially in US real estate sector, to ensure compliance and effective strategy implementation.
Ad Content and Policy Compliance
Emphasis on aligning ad content, keywords with Facebook's policies to avoid triggering AI-driven restrictions.
Avoid using images of people, sensitive keywords in ads to comply with Facebook's content policies.
Use of specific images or language, like people images and sensitive keywords, may trigger Facebook's AI restrictions.
Prepare, validate ads in Spanish language, focusing foreclosure content, ensure compliance with platform's policies.
Facebook Business Page Improvements
Enhancements to Facebook business page to improve visual appeal, content quality, and user engagement.
Add high-quality images, detailed descriptions to Facebook page for better representation of brand, more effective user engagement.
Pain Point
Difficulty in connecting with a human quickly during issues.
The team currently lacks a method to retrieve the money.
Address is being requested again in the form despite already being provided in the SMS responses, leading to redundancy in data collection.
Uncommitted changes need to be committed, and a recurring pop-up issue persists when clicking on links in the home contact section.
Contact details are generally expected from us, while others prefer not to share their own contact details on websites.
Researching loopholes to understand how AI is blocking accounts is necessary.
